description: Diwali Night - program was organised at Global Fusion- Andheri west on 30th Oct. it was a fun filled event. members along with their spouces, friends, brothers attended the event. the event started off with the president calling the event to order. it was followed by games, giftes for all. it was followed by dinner and fellowship.
